project_summary: The requested document-system architecture is already substantially present under src/chat/docs: Markdown with YAML id/title/description/keywords is canonical in the global AppData/docs folder; docs.db is colocated there; SQLite maintains lexical/BM25 and one hash/model-tracked embedding per doc; bounded hybrid retrieval uses configurable normalized scores and separate relevance threshold/result cap; Jev is a bounded optional relevance stage; prompts expose metadata-only references; and read_knowledge_doc safely reads one document per explicit agent call without automatic link traversal or extra model calls. Agent tool and prompt wiring is present in the existing agent callers.
assumptions: Treat the current implementation as the target architecture, not as a request to create a parallel or replacement subsystem beside it.
The global application documents location means Tauri BaseDirectory.AppData/docs; no document, index, database, or related content may be written into the repository.

The plan is a minimal gap/completion task because inspection found no evidenced functional gap in the requested behaviors; changes are conditional on focused checks revealing a concrete requirement-specific failure.
acceptance_criteria: All document Markdown and docs.db/index data remain exclusively under the global application documents directory; Markdown remains canonical and the index is recoverable from it.
Documents parse and persist id, title, description, and keywords in YAML frontmatter, with legacy compatibility maintained.
SQLite synchronization preserves BM25/keyword search, exactly one embedding per document, content-hash/model reuse and refresh behavior, and stale-row reconciliation.

Retrieval remains bounded, normalizes available BM25/keyword/embedding scores before configurable weighting, and applies Jev relevance evaluation separately from the relevance threshold and result cap.

Agent prompt context contains metadata-only references; the agent may explicitly call the safe read-one-document tool, and descriptive links are never crawled or fetched automatically and cause no additional model calls.
Only concrete failures against these criteria are fixed; existing APIs, fallbacks, and compatibility are preserved without introducing a duplicate document system or unrelated changes.

actions: Run the existing focused docs contract suites: src/chat/docs/doc-storage.test.ts, doc-frontmatter.test.ts, doc-index.test.ts, doc-search.test.ts, docs-jev.test.ts, docs-context.test.ts, docs-integration.test.ts, and src/services/ai/tools/docs_tools.test.ts.

Use failures as the gate for edits: if all requested contracts pass, make no implementation changes; if a requirement-specific contract fails, fix only the directly implicated existing module(s) in src/chat/docs or src/services/ai/tools/docs_tools.ts and its focused test. Preserve the current global AppData/docs storage, canonical Markdown/recoverable SQLite design, and explicit single-read tool flow.
Do not introduce a parallel storage/index/retrieval system, repository-local document artifacts, automatic link crawling, or extra model calls.
steps.expected_result: The existing implementation is confirmed complete for the requested architecture, or only evidenced requirement-specific gaps are closed; focused docs and tool tests pass without unrelated changes.
